prompt:
Deliverable: one chibi battle sprite sheet, a single 16:9 landscape image holding exactly eight separate full-body figures of the same character, one image only. It is a game animation sheet; the reference images are numbered below the prompt.
SUBJECT: Fadyme, an adult woman aged 22, drawn in compact chibi proportion: 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head, small hands and small feet, and adult facial features (narrow eyes with an upper eyelid line, a small nose, an adult jaw, never a round child-like face). Take her identity from reference image 1: pale ash-blonde hair (a cool light beige-blonde with ash-grey shading) falling past her shoulders from under the hood, violet eyes, a deep plum hood raised over her head (mid-tone #45293B, shadow #22151E) with one small broken fragment of a silver circlet, a short arc with a few small points and one snapped end, pinned at its front edge above the brow, a tiny silver bell-shaped hairpin half hidden at the side of her face under the hood, a deep plum hooded mantle over a high-collar black dress, silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) vine embroidery drawn as simple thin lines along the hood edge, the mantle hem and the skirt hem, a high clean white scarf (#E9E2D4), thin gloves and plain dark boots. She carries a silver bell on a continuous silver chain held in a gloved hand; its clapper is a silver thorn hanging straight down. The face, costume and props are identical in all eight figures. Her expression is calm with a trace of fatigue in the eyes and a small closed-mouth half-smile unless a pose says otherwise.
LAYOUT: eight figures on one flat pure #00FF00 background, arranged in four columns and two rows. Imagine the canvas divided into eight equal areas, each one quarter of the image width and one half of the image height, and place exactly one figure at the centre of each area. Reading order left to right, then top to bottom: top row 1 idle, 2 walk, 3 basic attack, 4 active skill; bottom row 5 ultimate, 6 hit reaction, 7 defeat, 8 victory. All eight figures are drawn at one identical scale, as eight different poses of the same character and not a turnaround: the standing idle figure is about 64% of the area height; the walk, basic attack, active skill and victory figures are the same height or within a tenth of it; the hit reaction is about 90% of it; the ultimate is the largest at about 115% of it; the defeat figure is the smallest at about 55% of it. The lowest point of every figure (the planted sole, or the knee in the defeat pose) rests on one shared horizontal baseline about 85% of the way down its area, with nothing hanging below it. Every figure, with its cloak, weapon, chain and bell, lies completely inside its own area and is separated from every neighbouring figure and from the image border by flat empty green at least as wide as twelve percent of one figure's width, so nothing touches or overlaps. Each prop stays physically attached to its figure (the bell hangs from a continuous chain held in the hand, the sword and shield stay in the hands and on the arm). The sheet carries no grid lines, frames, numbers, captions, arrows, shadows or ground.
POSES, every figure facing the right of the frame in a three-quarter view: 1 idle: relaxed stance with the weight on one leg, the chain held in both gloved hands at waist height and the bell hanging below them. 2 walk: mid-stride with one boot lifted and the other planted, the bell swinging gently from the lower hand, the mantle trailing behind her. 3 basic attack, a thrust of the bell's thorn: the front arm stretched straight out to the right at shoulder height, the gloved fist holding the chain taut so the bell hangs at the end of the arm with its silver thorn pointing toward the target, the other arm drawn in, the body leaning forward, eyes narrowed. 4 active skill, the bell raised: one gloved hand lifts the bell on its taut chain to head height beside her face while the other hand rests open at waist height, eyes closed, composed. 5 ultimate: her largest pose, both arms raised high above her head holding the chain so the bell is lifted at the top with its thorn pointing down, the mantle lifted outward around her, head tilted slightly back, eyes closed. 6 hit reaction: recoil, the upper body flinching back to the left, one arm thrown up in front of her face, eyes shut tight, teeth clenched, the bell swinging out on its chain. 7 defeat: collapsed on her knees and folded forward, head bowed under the hood, the bell resting on the ground beside her knee on its chain, the mantle pooled around her. 8 victory: standing composed, the bell held at chest height in one gloved hand and the other hand resting over her heart, a small gentle smile, head slightly tilted.
STYLE: compact chibi game-sprite illustration in a dark gothic anime register, drawn with one uniform bold outline in deep ink (#120A18) about 2 to 3 percent of the figure height, closed shapes, flat two-tone cel shading with one small hard highlight per material, matte woven cloth suggested by a few short hatching strokes, faces simplified but with readable eyes; flat colour areas only, no gradients, no airbrush, no gloss.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: the same soft light from the upper left on every figure with no cast shadows; deep plum, charcoal black, bone ivory and silver-lilac in restrained low saturation, darkest value #0F0D11, never pure black.
TECHNICAL: the background is flat pure #00FF00, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, floor, vignette, shadow, glow, mist or particles; every figure has a crisp, hard, closed outline so it separates cleanly from the green; no green anywhere on the figures and no green rim light or reflection on cloth or metal; the hair is drawn as thick clumped locks without thin flyaway strands; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters or numbers; grid lines or frames; ground shadows; magic or impact effects; blood; a crimson or burgundy costume; dangling bell charms; a full tiara; modern items; extra fingers or limbs; a second character.
